modifier.mmd-toxic.name: 毒性
modifier.mmd-toxic.desc: Rather dangerous - will poison and blind things hit with tools or weapons.
modifier.mmd-sparkly.name: 閃耀
modifier.mmd-soft.name: 柔軟
modifier.mmd-soft.desc: Not really good for tools that will see a lot of use as they'll wear out faster
modifier.mmd-brittle.name: 脆弱
modifier.mmd-brittle.desc: As it breaks down it does more damage - but beware, it will hurt you as well!
modifier.mmd-heavy.name: 沉重
modifier.mmd-heavy.desc: This stuff is really, really dense - it'll tire you out faster to use any tools made from this
modifier.mmd-reactive.name: 高活性
modifier.mmd-reactive.desc: Reacts with water to wear out faster
modifier.mmd-radioactive.name: 放射性
modifier.mmd-radioactive.desc: Dangerous to hold and use unless you can somehow shield yourself from the effects.
modifier.toxic-modifier.name: 毒性
modifier.toxic-modifier.desc: §oTOXIC AVENGER!§r\nMercury and it's ethyl and methyl salts are extremely toxic and have neuro-degenerative effects.\nAdding some to a weapon or tool gives it the ability to poison and temporarily blind your enemies.
modifier.lead-plated.name: 鉛板
modifier.lead-plated.desc: §oSafety First§r\nIf you've got some Plutonium or Uranium around and think it'd be great for a weapon, don't forget to add some shielding.\nA nice lead plate will stop the deadly radiation from affection you while still letting it harm your enemies.
config.basemetals.title: Base Metals 設定
config.basemetals.contentMode.tooltip: 選擇用金屬製作物品時的自由程度。礦石生成不受影響。
config.basemetals.content_mode.high_fant: 自由使用所有金屬。全部配方、村民交易和寶箱物品都可取得。
config.basemetals.content_mode.low_fanta: 保留奇幻金屬，但限制每種材料能製作的物品。不提供 Base Metals 的弓、弩和釣竿。
config.basemetals.specialEffects.tooltip: 讓部分金屬裝備擁有特殊的盔甲和近戰效果，例如穿齊 Aquarium 盔甲後可在水下呼吸。
手持星鋼裝備時，每10秒恢復1點耐久度。盔甲不會自我修復。
config.basemetals.mercuryImmersionEffect: 接觸液態汞可能讓你噁心。
config.basemetals.villagerTrades.tooltip: 讓鐵匠出售 Base Metals 的錠和裝備。
config.basemetals.confirm.title: 變更內容模式？
config.basemetals.confirm.message: 重新啟動 Minecraft 後即可使用新模式。你已有的物品仍可使用。加入伺服器時，請選擇與伺服器相同的模式。
config.basemetals.restart: 變更模式後請重新啟動 Minecraft。此選擇對你的所有世界生效。礦石的生成位置可在 OreSpawn 中調整。
config.basemetals.connection.mismatch: 此伺服器使用%s，你的遊戲使用%s。請在 Mods → Base Metals → Config 中選擇相同的模式，然後重新啟動 Minecraft。
